There are **8 distinct declarations** of a `Close` method across the Go codebase (6 in non-test code, 2 in test-only code):

| # | File | Line | Receiver | Signature |
|---|------|------|----------|-----------|
| 1 | `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` | 99 | `*SSEHub` | `func (h *SSEHub) Close()` |
| 2 | `/bench/repo/store/store.go` | 72 | `*Store` | `func (s *Store) Close() error` |
| 3 | `/bench/repo/store/cache/cache.go` | 187 | `*Cache` | `func (c *Cache) Close() error` |
| 4 | `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go` | 67 | `*DB` (sqlite) | `func (d *DB) Close() error` |
| 5 | `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/postgres.go` | 46 | `*DB` (postgres) | `func (d *DB) Close() error` |
| 6 | `/bench/repo/store/db/mysql/mysql.go` | 47 | `*DB` (mysql) | `func (d *DB) Close() error` |
| 7 | `/bench/repo/store/test/filter_helpers_test.go` | 200 | `*MemoFilterTestContext` | `func (tc *MemoFilterTestContext) Close()` (test only) |
| 8 | `/bench/repo/store/test/filter_helpers_test.go` | 282 | `*AttachmentFilterTestContext` | `func (tc *AttachmentFilterTestContext) Close()` (test only) |

Notes on the three DB types (#4-6): all three implement the `store.Driver` interface, which declares `Close() error`. Each implementation delegates to `d.db.Close()` where `d.db` is a `*sql.DB`.
